description: Validate a Renovate configuration against the official schema using renovate-config-validator. Pass either configPath (file on disk) or configContent (inline JSON object). Validates as a repo config by default; set configType to "global" for a self-hosted global config. Returns validation output and a boolean `valid`.

configContent.description: Inline config object to validate (written to a temp file)

configPath.description: Absolute path to a config file to validate (.json, .json5, .jsonc, .yaml, .yml or .renovaterc)

configType.description: Validate as a repo config (default) or as a self-hosted global config (platform, autodiscover, token, ...)

name: validate_config
title: Validate Renovate config
